risks.risk: Inaccurate percent complete inflates EV and hides overruns
risks.mitigation: B11 validation rules; define physical progress criteria per task type

risks.risk: Baseline changes without change control mask true variance
risks.mitigation: B10 baseline change log; report re-baselines with change-request ids

risks.risk: Timesheet lag understates AC, so CPI looks better than reality
risks.mitigation: B12 lag check; accrue estimated cost for missing timesheet weeks

risks.risk: Linear PV spread misrepresents front- or back-loaded tasks
risks.mitigation: Document the assumption; add optional per-task spread curves after M7

risks.risk: Excel and Smartsheet exports vary in columns and date formats
risks.mitigation: Column mapping file and strict loader validation with clear errors (M7)

risks.risk: LLM summary states facts that are not in the computed JSON
risks.mitigation: Prompt restricted to the facts JSON; deterministic fallback; tests never call the network

risks.risk: Power BI template drifts from the summary.json schema
risks.mitigation: Versioned export schema and a test that checks required fields (M8)

risks.risk: Synthetic sample data is cleaner than real project data
risks.mitigation: State it in the README; loaders reject malformed input instead of guessing
